reviews.text:
Very caring, reasonable price
& great service, KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK 🐶🐶🐕🐕🐾🐾🦴🦴 …

Our ELMO has stayed at the Miami Gardens "Resort" at least five times over the last four years.  I know he enjoys socializing with other Breeds, BIG & small. ELMO is calm, like an Oldman in a much younger body.  He is an interesting Mixed-Breed of Bulldog & 50% Shiba Inu. When he arrives and we go through the doors, he gets excited and when the attendant leads him into the door to the open bay , he doesn't even look back as to say "bye" folks.
I'm very straightforward in how I want my dog to look like after grooming. I'm never disappointed with DGW. Affordable and great service.
The are nice. They send reports and pictures of the boarding dogs. You can see the dogs while you are out.

I had used this place before a couple of times and we had a good experience overall, but our last stay wasn’t too good. First I asked them to trim my dog’s nails which they didn’t buy the worst part I pick her up sick, she had horrible bloody diarrhea/throwing up for 3 days straight. Called them to let them know about it and they said they have no idea.
Told two different prices from when I dropped him off then picked up. L service
Loving Natalia as a groomer ❤️❤️❤️❤️

I bring my pug puppy here 3x a week and she loves this place. Loves the staff there and all her new Fur Friends. I highly recommend bringing your pup here for Daycare n all the other services they provide. Just a really GREAT Team here. Thank you guys for taking care of Shailah!!
I want to continue to tell everyone if you love your fur baby n need a place for them to go for daycare grooming overnight this is the BEST PLACE IN SOUTH FLORIDA! The staff is AMAZING your baby is always in good hands with them. The prices are incredibly affordable.  Even if you want your pup to spend a day playing with other fur babies this is the place. It's like taking a child to Disney they come out of there excited happy n exhausted from playing all day. Can't say enough about you guys your AWESOME. Thank you for treating Shailah like your own.
Jake our bulldog loves it there
Worse experience ever. Horrible service

First time taking my 10 month old Newfie to a daycare and she LOVED it! She’s a bit shy around people + dogs so we figured to socialize her and everyone there treated her wonderful. Now she absolutely lights up whenever we turn the corner! Her notes on the report card; that they send me every-time she goes, are the funniest things ever. + the photos they take of her are so cute! Will be coming her back here whenever I’m busy and  she can’t be left alone!

I had a very bad experience with this place. I left my dog for 3 nights, and when I made the reservation over the phone, they offered me a bath service. I clearly said that I did NOT want the bath. When I picked her up, they were still trying to charge me for it. They reviewed the recorded call and you can clearly hear me refusing the bath service.

Even then, an employee told me it was “company policy,” but when I asked for the policy in writing, nowhere does it say that dogs must be bathed after 3 nights. They basically have “verbal policies” that are not written down, yet they still try to charge for them.

This is unprofessional and not transparent. They should not be charging for services the customer did not authorize. I will not be returning and I do not recommend this place.
I thank you'll for everything. I wouldn't have been able to enjoy the trip. Knowing that Cujo was there with you'll I didn't worry about anything. Love ❤️ you'll
Charlie loves hanging out at doggies! Loves the attention from everyone! He goes everyday and I feel great  knowing he’s in good hands!
Very friendly team!

I am a first time client. I made and appointment for my little girl pug “Gertie” it was late an appointment, weather was really bad and raining. Although they mobile groomer was stuck in traffic they still came and took care of my baby girl “Gertie”. I am very impressed with their service and professionalism and they now have me and “Gertie” as forever clients . Doggie’s Gone Wild is the friendliest and the absolute best . If your looking for the BEST , look no further , they feel like family , they will take care of you rain or sunshine and perhaps even in a Hurricane. Thank you again for exceptional service .

I have been bringing my Grand Dog Ghost here for over 7 years for boarding, day care and grooming.  I have nothing but positive things to say!  The staff takes such great care of Ghost, and they even send pictures of his stay!  He loves going to day care here and playing with this friends.   Even if your dog does not play well with other dogs, they will make sure he/she feels welcome and give individual attention!   Thank you to all of the staff and owner, Marco!   This is the best doggie day care!

BIGGIES FAVORITE PLACE TO BE they have fun activities for the puppies and literally celebrate the holidays and birthdays of the puppies! They are treated with care and love and I love when he gets groomed he smells so yummy! The staff are amazing and they all have a relationship with each dog in the doggies gone wild puppy family.

Love it, worked well with my dog (Lucky). The cut was perfect, and he smelled real good, too. I got so many compliments. I never heard about them. I found them online and called them. Same day appointment. I had no problem.

I take my Basenji there once a month. Great service, super friendly staff and you can schedule same day service if you call early on in the day. Which works for people who have a busy schedule. Oh and they do a great job of shampoo and nail trimming. My dog doesn't have long hair but they do offer hair clipping. 10/10.

Love this doggy day care and so does my dog - seriously, he pulls me on the leash to go inside! 😂 the staff is very friendly and gives daily updates with photos. They also do a good job with grooming. Highly recommend! …
Doggies gone wild is a great place for your pets especially if you’re traveling. I love that they kept me updated on my puppy 🐶 pebbles . …

Lifesavers! We had to find a new daycare for our Boston Terrier (previous one was also amazing but was way too far). They were accommodating but also very professional, screening the dog before starting. They provide daily updates and always pay close attention to our pup. He loooves Daniel, Tra'Shay and all the rest of the staff. Going 5 times a week for basically a year without any issues whatsoever.

I have never felt uncomfortable when leaving my dog for the weekend with the friendly and caring staff. The atmosphere is clean and the staff genuinely cares about the needs and well being of my dog. My dog actually gets excited when she realizes where she is going for the weekend!

Since day one we have had nothing but great experiences at Doggies Gone Wild! My mini Australian Shepherd, Solo, loves loves loves coming here. As soon as we park he is excited to spend the day with the staff and other doggos! We recently used them for an overnight stay and would definitely use them again. Staff is always friendly, the daily pictures also demonstrates the care and attention Solo gets, and the fun events make this daycare worthwhile. Definitely recommend bringing your fur babies here!
DGW always have great customer service!! Absolutely love them!!
